description: Find text in the page like the browser's find bar: highlights every match in the live document, scrolls the current one into view, and steps with next / previous. close clears the highlights. Returns count and the 1-based index.

action.description: `search` (default: run the query from the top), `next`, `previous`, or `close`.

query.description: Text to look for. Empty with `action: close` clears the search.

count.description: Number of matches in the visible text of the page.

index.description: 1-based index of the highlighted match; 0 when there is none.

query.description: The query the counts refer to.
